about: The Inclusionist font library (ADR-0255): every family the engine does not draw with itself, one folder per family in the-inclusionist-lfs/fonts/, delivered on a cartridge's `uses.fonts` by `inclusionist-heavy --fonts`. Each face: its file, weight, style, unicode-range (a key of `ranges`), bytes and sha256; `from` is the author's original a reserved-name family is compressed from (ADR-0254). Rewritten only with the folders (scripts/licences/fonts.mjs --library checks each file against it).
